content: Production map-authoring tools define the component shape of an indoor graph editor. ArcGIS Indoors Floor Plan Editor: a browser app with Plan/Edit/Draw/Split/Place/Copy/Merge/Manage-plan/Import/Grid/Images tools; 'Place' inserts entryways, windows and floor transitions as typed features; 'Grid' gives snap spacing/rotation; 'Images' adds a bitmap floor plan with adjustable transparency to trace over; changes live in a working 'plan' that is reviewed and then pushed to the default plan (draft -> publish). Open Location Stack Floor Plan Editor: React + Vite + TypeScript + IndexedDB + MapLibre, local-first, IMDF-oriented, with explicit 'Routing paths' authoring, corner-based control points to align a bitmap floor-plan overlay to vector geometry, and GeoJSON/IMDF import-export plus validation. Pattern for this project: admin panel = floor-plan bitmap backdrop + vector node/edge overlay + grid snapping + publish step + validation before publish.
